findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed that sanitizing solution (quaternary ammonium) in the sanitizer buckets was testing between 0ppm-100ppm, which below an effective concentration of that sanitizer. CORRECTED: PIC remade each bucket and tested the chemical concentrations to be at a safe and effective concentrations between 200-400ppm. Ensure that chemical sanitizer is used per EPA-registered label use instructions, and is tested frequently for a safe and effective concentration.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(C) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (C) A quaternary ammonium compound solution shall: (1) Have a minimum temperature of 24°C (75°F), (2) Have a concentration as specified under § 7-204.11 and as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling, and (3) Be used only in water with 500 MG/L hardness or less or in water having a hardness no greater than specified by the EPA-registered label use instructions. [P]

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices.
findings.comment: Observed that the handwashing sink in the back is leaking wastewater during usage. PIC was notified and contacted a repair person for a timely repair. Inspector will Follow Up to confirm the repair. Ensure that all plumbing is maintained in good repair to prevent contamination or slips, trips, or falls.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.15(B) System Maintained in Good Repair. A plumbing system shall be: (B) Maintained in good repair. [C]

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used.
findings.comment: Observed several personal items (phones, wallets, keys, drinks, etc.) being stored in food prep or food storage areas. CORRECTED: PIC and Inspector discussed long-term solutions for employee item storage, including using the office shelves in the back of the store, or providing separate bins for employee storage. PIC had employees move personal items to the office shelves during the inspection. Ensure that designated areas are used for employee personal items to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, clean linens, single-service and single-use articles.
findings.citation_text: 6-403.11(B) Designated Areas. (B) Lockers or other suitable facilities shall be located in a designated room or area where contamination of FOOD, EQUIPMENT, UTENSILS, LINENS, and SINGLESERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES can not occur. [C]

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: Observed an employee did not use a barrier to turn off the faucet after hand washing. The PIC will be educating employees about the proper hand washing procedure. Ensure that a barrier is always used to turn off the faucet after hand washing to avoid re-contaminating clean hands.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.12(C) Cleaning Procedure. (C) To avoid recontaminating their hands or surrogate prosthetic devices, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use disposable paper towels or similar clean barriers when touching surfaces such as manually operated faucet handles on a HANDWASHING SINK or the handle of a restroom door.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
6-301.11: Observed there was not hand soap at the hand-sink at the front of the facility. Ensure there is hand soap provided at every hand-washing sink in the facility. The PIC provided hand soap to the hand-washing sink at the front of the facility during the inspection. 

6-301.11: Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap.

findings.title: In-use utensils: properly stored
findings.comment:
3-304.12: Observed an ice scoop stored on top of the ice machine which does not appear to be cleaned and sanitized due to the presence of dust. Ensure all utensils are stored on clean, sanitized surfaces. This is a repeat violation from 1/9/2023.

3-304.12: FOOD preparation and dispensing UTENSILS shall be stored: (A) in FOOD with their handles above top of FOOD and container (B) In non-TCS FOOD (C) On clean portion of FOOD preparation table or cooking EQUIPMENT as long as UTENSIL cleaned with proper frequency (Time/Temp Control Form). (D) In running water with sufficient velocity (E) In clean, protected location if UTENSILS are used only for FOOD not TCS (F) In container of water at least 135F and container is properly cleaned.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-602.13: Observed the outside of the ice chests have an accumulation of soil. Ensure that all equipment is cleaned at a frequency necessary to avoid accumulation of soil residues.   

4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: Observed the protection coating on the outside of the ice-cream mix cooler to be peeling and not easily cleanable. Ensure that all physical facilities are maintained in good repair. 

6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
Inspector observed an employee who washed hands then turned the faucet off without a barrier (paper towel). Employee was instructed to re-wash and did not use soap. Ensure that staff is trained on proper hand washing procedure. 2nd employee did so correctly. Corrected on site. Work with staff to ensure continued compliance. 

2-301.12: (A) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of arms for at least 20 seconds. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use proper procedure (C) To prevent recontamination, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use barrier to operate faucet handles. (D) Automatic handwashing facility may be used if APPROVED.

findings.title: Food properly labeled; original container
findings.comment:
A container of white granules to the right of the espresso machine was unlabeled. Ensure that containers of easily mistaken food are labeled. 

3-302.12: If in working container, FOOD not readily recognized or easily mistakable shall be identified with the common name of the FOOD.

findings.title: Wiping cloths: properly used and stored
findings.comment:
Wiping cloths in containers of water under espresso machines must be stored in sanitizer solution. Inspector tested containers for sanitizer and no sanitizer was used. Ensure that wiping cloths are stored in sanitizer solution between uses. 

3-304.14: (A) Cloths in-use for wiping FOOD spills for TABLEWARE and carryout containers shall be dry and used for no other purpose. (B) Cloths in-use for wiping counters and EQUIPMENT surfaces shall be held between uses in chemical sanitizer at proper solution and laundered daily. (C) Cloths in-use for wiping raw animal FOOD surfaces shall be separate from other cloths. (D) Dry wiping cloths and sanitizing solution shall be free of FOOD debris and other soil. (E) Containers of sanitizing solution shall be stored off floor and used in manner to prevent contamination. (F) SINGLE-USE disposable sanitizer wipes shall be used in accordance with EPA labels.

findings.title: In-use utensils: properly stored
findings.comment:
Ice scoops stored of top of the ice machine which does not appear to be cleaned and sanitized (confirmed by person-in-charge) due to the presence of dust. Ensure all utensils are stored on clean, sanitized surfaces. 

3-304.12: FOOD preparation and dispensing UTENSILS shall be stored: (A) in FOOD with their handles above top of FOOD and container (B) In non-TCS FOOD (C) On clean portion of FOOD preparation table or cooking EQUIPMENT as long as UTENSIL cleaned with proper frequency (Time/Temp Control Form). (D) In running water with sufficient velocity (E) In clean, protected location if UTENSILS are used only for FOOD not TCS (F) In container of water at least 135F and container is properly cleaned.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Water continues to come from the wall underneath the hand sink on the North wall. Operator states this is from wet rag storage, however, this would indicate that there is an area subject to moisture which is not sealed. Ensure that this is corrected by the next routine inspection. 

6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. (B) In TEMPORARY FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, floor may be material effectively treated to control dust and mud. Walls and ceilings may be material that protects interior from weather and windblown dust and debris.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used
findings.comment:
Personal drinks were observed stored above ice on the ice machine. Have a designated area for personal drinks.

6-403.11: (A) Areas designated for EMPLOYEES to eat, drink, and use tobacco shall be located so that FOOD, EQUIPMENT, LINENS, and SINGLESERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES are protected from contamination. (B) Lockers or other suitable facilities shall be located in a designated room or area where contamination of FOOD, EQUIPMENT, UTENSILS, LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES cannot occur.
